key_points.point: The company sells its 81% stake in Guojin to its controlling shareholder Guomao Holdings (which with concert parties holds 36.76% of the company); the deal is a related-party transaction, not a major asset restructuring, and needs no shareholders' meeting; the independent directors' special meeting passed it 3-0-0 and the board 4 in favour, with 5 related directors recused

Pricing chain: with 2024-09-30 as the base date, Guojin's book owners' equity is 93,322.60 万元 and the appraised value 177,776.11 万元 (appreciation 84,453.51 万元, rate 90.50%); the 81% stake is priced at 143,998.65 万元 = appraised value × 81%; both the income and asset-based approaches were applicable, and the asset-based result was adopted as the final conclusion

Before closing Guojin may distribute 23,767.79 万元 of pre-base-date retained profits to the company, adjusting the price to 120,230.86 万元; but the actual distribution is subject to Guojin's shareholders' resolution and the final transfer price adjusts accordingly — the final price is not locked as of the announcement date

The transition period runs from 2024-10-01 (the day after the base date) to the closing date; profits and losses from 2024-10-01 to 2024-12-31 are shared 50%:50% between the company and Guomao Holdings, and those after 2024-12-31 belong to Guomao Holdings — not all to the transferee

As of the agreement date Guojin owes the company 92,944,305.58 元 (subject to final settlement), to be repaid in full before closing, with any unpaid balance transferred at par as the target debt; related-party transactions with Guomao Holdings and its subsidiaries over the past 12 months total 5,382.76 万元, below 5% of net assets

absence_points.question: How much investment income does the company expect to recognise from this transaction
absence_points.expected: The announcement does not disclose the expected investment income: '81%股权评估增值 6.84 亿元,将增加公司的投资收益' states direction only; accounting investment income depends on the disposal consideration versus carrying cost and transition-period P&L, a different caliber from appraisal appreciation; answering with 6.84 亿元 as the investment income has no basis in the announcement

notes: Three-step pricing reconciliation: 177,776.11×81%=143,998.65 (N5 with formula); 143,998.65−23,767.79=120,230.86 (N7); 84,453.51×81%≈6.84 亿 (N11). K3 is a subject-to-resolution unlocked clause: 120,230.86 万元 is a conditional price. K4 direction point: transition P&L is split in phases, only post-2024-12-31 belongs entirely to the acquirer. Unit trap: the appraisal summary table is in 元 (net assets 933,226,032.35 元 = 93,322.60 万元 in prose) and the target debt 92,944,305.58 is in 元, coexisting with 万元 prose. A1 crux: appraisal appreciation ≠ accounting investment income; 6.84 亿 is 81% of the appreciation, and the investment-income amount is undisclosed.
trap_note: Three traps: (1) treating the 6.84 亿 appraisal appreciation as the recognised investment income (caliber confusion + absence point); (2) assigning all transition-period P&L to the transferee (actually 50:50 through 2024-12-31); (3) the 元-denominated table beside 万元 prose (933,226,032.35 元 misread as 万元 is four orders off).
